description: An image declared as JPEG2000 (/Filter /JPXDecode) with invalid stream data.

expected.note: Construction fact: one image XObject with /Filter /JPXDecode and data that is NOT a valid JP2 codestream (256 zero bytes). It does not test correct JPEG2000 decoding (that needs a real file, see tools/calibrate-images.ts) — it tests only that extractDirect() never silently skips a failed decode: either page.objs.get()/commonObjs.get() throws/returns a null-like value and a Diagnostic is reported (IMAGE_DECODE_FAILED/IMAGE_DECODE_EMPTY), or (if pdf.js for some reason returns anything) the image is normalized without an error — both outcomes are acceptable, a silent absence of a trace is not.
